newsitem.title: USA: Able Q2 oper profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: Able Q2 oper profit vs loss.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Full company name is Able Telcom Holding Corp.
Net income is after deduction for preferred stock dividends of $75,000 and $110,000 for the three and six months ended April 30, 1997.

The company said net income was further reduced by previously reported one-time non-cash charges of $439,600 in the 1997 three month period and $572,600 for the 1997 six month period, connected to conversion on its convertible preferred stock issued in December 1996.
The company reported net earnings of $0.04 per share for the second quarter of 1997, or $337,378, and $0.08 per share for the six months, or $674,617.
